FULL TEXT:
. IRUNACHAL PRADESHLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
ITANAGAR
No. APPSC-12/37/2024 Dated Itanagar, the 29
th
September, 2025
ADVERTISEMENT
NO.
05/2025
The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission invites application for filling up
of
22 (Twenty Two) posts
of
Section Officer through Limited Departmental Competitive
Examination (LDCE) from the Grade
of
Assistant Section Officer (ASO), Arunachal Pradesh Civil
Secretariat for filling up
of
following posts
of
Section Officer Group-B (Gazetted) in the Pay
Matrix in Level-8 (~47,600/- to 1,51,100/-) as admissible under rule.
The post wise vacancy detail is tabulated below:
SI.
No.
Name of Post Reserved for APST
Unreserved Total Post
1 Section Officer
17
(Seventeen)
05
(Five) 22 (Twenty Two)
(A)ELIGIBILITY
A. Bachelor Degree/ Graduation in any subject from recognized University.
B. Minimum 05 years
of
regular service in the grade
of
ASO.
C. Possessing at least 5 (five) "Very Good" consecutive APAR grading for the last 05 years.
(B) HOWTOAPPLY
(1) Application Form is available for download in the APPSC website https://appsc.gov.in. The
duly filled-in application form must be recommended by the Cadre Controlling Authority along
with details
of
the APAR grading
of
last five consecutive years.
(2) Only applications nominated by the Cadre Controlling Authority with at-least five 'Very
Good' consecutive APAR grading
of
last 5 (five) years shall be considered.
(3) The duly filled-in application forms nominated by the Cadre Controlling Authority must also
enclose the documents listed herein at (E).
(4) All such duly nominated applications must be submitted in the office
of
APPSC on or before
30
th
October, 2025 (Thursday) by 3:00
pm
through Cadre Controlling Authority.
(C) METHOD OF SELECTION
The eligible candidate will have to appear in written examination in the following subjects
followed by Viva-Voce to be conducted by the Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission.
SL Subject/Paper Marks
No.
1 General English (Objective) 100
AP Secretariat Manual of Office Procedure 80
2 Drafting/ Constitution of India (Objective)
3 FR & SR/GFR/CCS(CCA) (Objective) 100
Page 1 of 3
4 ACR Grading
of
last 5 years 20
5 Viva Voce 40
6 Total 340
Note: In order to qualify for interview, candidates must score an aggregate
of
33%
of
the
total marks in the written examination comprising
of
three papers, subject to condition that
the candidate scores at least
20%,
in each Subject/ Paper
of
the written examination.
. In case the number
of
applicants is more than the desired ratio, the Commission may
conduct a Recruitment Test, the details
of
which will be notified separately.
(D) Candidates are required to pay fee
of
~150/- (Rupees One Hundred Fifty) only for APST
candidate and
~
200/- (Rupees Two Hundred) only for other candidate in form
of
Treasury challan
payable
to
Secretary, APPSC, Itanagar under Head
of
Account- 0051, 102 - State PSC.
(E) DOCUMENTS REQUIRED TO BE SUBMITTED ALONG WITH THE APPLICATION
FORM
1.
Latest/Recent color passport size photo. The photograph is to be in white background, front
faced and without headgear and sunglasses.
2. Self-Attested photocopy
of
Degree certificates and Mark Sheets issued by the Assistant
Registrar/Registrar/Controller
of
Examination/Vice-Chancellor
of
the concerned University
to ascertain degree.
3. Self-Attested photocopy
of
Matriculation Certificate for proof
of
age issued by the Board.
4. Self-Attested Photocopy
of
APST certificate and copy
of
PRC/Aadhar Card in case
of
General candidates.5. Self- Attested photocopy
of
appointment order to the post.
6. Treasury challan
of
amount deposited as fee.
(F) LAST DATE FOR SUBMISSION OF APPLICATION: 30
th
October, 2025 (Thursday)
NOTE:
(1) The decision
of
the Commission as to the eligibility or otherwise
of
candidate for admission to
written examination/interview or selection will be final and no correspondence or personal
enquiry will be entertained.
(2) Date for Written Examination is scheduled on 28
th
November 2025 (Friday). Date
of
Interview
of
eligible candidates shall be intimated separately.
(3) Eligible candidates will have to produce the above-mentioned (at Point E)
Certificates/Documents and Mark Sheets in original at the time
of
interview, failing which
he/she will not be allowed to appear in the interview.
(4) The Selection will be provisional and subject to verification
of
requisite documents/
qualifications by the indenting department.
